name: Rigret
source:
The form taken on by the Goddess of Winter, Rigret, after she has succumbed to corruption by Loki.

Having been thoroughly corrupted, her transient yet pure and innocent personality has completely vanished, and she has become an impish devil who tricks and deceives men.

Because she seems almost like an innocent kitten, there is nothing more cruel than being faced with the reality of her personality on a battlefield as an enemy soldier.

After being corrupted by Loki, she now has a strong desire to monopolise, and therefore just about always clings to him, wanting attention. However, he seems to find this annoying, and usually manages to throw her off or give her the slip.

「Will you praise me more, Loki? Faith is power...My Gjallarhorn can grant blessings, and with that, everyone would willingly, happily die for me」

Weapon name: Gjallarjorn
